name: Neu-Ulm (Germany)
description: Hanging banner with vertical stripes of black, white and blue, charged above the centre with the city arms of Neu-Ulm (a white tower on black over blue and white).
history: Municipal flag of Neu-Ulm; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.
